mapper.select: SELECT from_point.id AS fromPointId, from_course.id AS fromCourseId, from_course.user_id AS fromCourseOwnerId, from_course.course_type AS fromCourseType, to_point.id AS toPointId, to_course.id AS toCourseId, to_course.user_id AS toCourseOwnerId, to_course.course_type AS toCourseType FROM knowledge_points from_point INNER JOIN courses from_course ON from_course.id = from_point.course_id INNER JOIN knowledge_points to_point ON to_point.id = #{toPointId} INNER JOIN courses to_course ON to_course.id = to_point.course_id WHERE from_point.id = #{fromPointId}
